resolved_intents.intent: Perform valid login with username and password
Search for product and add to cart

missing_methods.intent: Verify dashboard header profile name is visible
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Wait for the dashboard header profile name element to be visible on the page. This method should locate the profile name element in the dashboard header and verify its visibility state. Return True if visible, False otherwise.
implementation_checklist: Wait for 'profile_name' element to be visible using wait_for(state='visible')
Check visibility state of 'profile_name' element using is_visible()
Return True if 'profile_name' is visible, False otherwise

missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Wait for the dashboard header profile name element and retrieve its text content. Compare the actual profile name text with the expected_name parameter. Assert that they match exactly. Raise an assertion error with a descriptive message if they do not match.
implementation_checklist: Wait for 'profile_name' element to be visible using wait_for(state='visible')
Get text content from 'profile_name' element using text_content() or inner_text()
Compare actual profile name text with expected_name parameter
Use expect() assertion to verify text matches expected_name
Raise assertion error with descriptive message if texts do not match exactly
